subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle physics surface for wave_003_vehicle_physics_01: wheel contact-height probing against the spatial terrain grid, time-sliced three-phase wheel dynamics processing (friction/suspension/proximity), collision-shape discriminator/subtype initialization, shape-to-bone and size-class mapping, brake/tire thermal integration and wear simulation on the live vehicle, retirement/failure driver-event commentary, the global active-vehicle pointer array and player-vehicle selection helpers, physics object init/teardown thunks, and the setup/statistics display formatters that present physics parameters (ride height, camber, ratios, speed estimates) to the garage menu.

summary: The vehicle_physics scope in this packet spans nine loosely coupled clusters with no proven common owner. (1) Wheel contact-height probing (0x00402220) computes the contact patch and suspension compression via terrain-height queries (SpatialGridQuery 0x0044C4C0); (2) a time-sliced wheel phase machine (0x00404460) runs at most 20 wheels per frame through friction/suspension/proximity phases against a per-run target grip; (3) collision-shape data (0x0040E990, 0x00412C30, 0x004139C0) carries a discriminator, subtype constant, pass-through and a secondary output, seeded via CollisionInvMassStore and F_6FieldBulkSetter; (4) per-vehicle camera/physics update iteration (0x004109D0) applies wheel contact transforms or dispatches render physics and camera-shake writes; (5) session retirement commentary (0x0041B250, owner SessionState) builds sentinel-initialized driver-table entries (event IDs 117-119 player, 235-238 AI) and inserts them into the session event table; (6) the global active-vehicle pointer array service (0x0042BBD0, 0x0042BC40, 0x0042BC80) builds the 104-entry dword_7C54F0 array and records player/vehicle indices; (7) the setup formatter (0x0042F470) and stats estimator (0x00430F00) render setup parameter and performance estimates into display buffers with metric/imperial unit selection and localized labels; (8) physics object lifecycle thunks (0x00433090, 0x00433E60 destructor/teardown, 0x00433870, 0x00434450, 0x00438CA0 init/step, 0x00431BD0 registration) with unproven owners; and (9) brake/tire thermal and wear integration (0x00438130, owner F1CVehicle DERIVED) that clamps integrated temperature, triggers a blowout-style degradation transition and dispatches pit/AI phase callbacks by slip classification. Most class boundaries and all field semantics are GUESS/DERIVED; the twenty-four dbl_59E* read-only globals and the string globals backing the setup formatter are recorded but not tied to literals by this packet.

function_roles.role: Wheel contact-height probe: computes the contact patch position from wheel geometry (origin, scale selector, direction), queries terrain height at the contact center and both side probes via SpatialGridQuery, resolves side-height disagreement beyond a 0.35 threshold, and writes compressed suspension height (center-average + 0.06) and lateral tilt (half the side-height difference) into the output.

Time-sliced three-phase wheel processing state machine: computes a per-run target grip from two global grip terms, and when the stored target differs beyond tolerance or the machine is mid-run, processes at most 20 wheels per call through phase 0 friction (sub_4FB260), phase 1 suspension (sub_4FAF60) and phase 2 proximity (VehicleProximity), advancing the phase selector and index, returning to idle with index -1 when a full batch completes.

Collision-shape type-1 initializer: writes the 16-bit discriminator into this+8, subtype constant 1 into this+28, stores the pass-through argument at this+32, seeds collision mass/inverse-mass bulk data via CollisionInvMassStore with a constant float array, bulk-sets six collision fields via F_6FieldBulkSetter, and continues into ShortComputation_e770 when the fourth argument is non-zero.

Per-frame per-vehicle camera/physics update tick: when the scoring gate is in direct-contact mode walks the global vehicle array applying wheel contact transforms (sub_4F0430 then WheelContactTransform 0x004EF180 per slot); otherwise iterates the receiver's camera-element array dispatching mode-ordered render physics (0x0040F300) and, on a coarse shake timer, writes camera-shake data for eligible elements (0x0040F600).

Collision-shape-to-bone mapping: dispatches on a shape identifier (1-12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50) via the jump-table/case globals and computes a bone index (153-189) by subtracting a boolean flag from a shape-specific base; on success writes the bone index to this+8, the sub_414180(0) result to this+0xC, and returns 1 (or -1 when the argument flags or shape are invalid).

Collision-shape size classification: promotes the size argument to double and walks an ascending chain of threshold doubles (dbl_59E788..dbl_59E7E0, 1.0..52.5) with the upper tail split by integer bounds 75/110/999, writing the class index to this+8 and the sub_414180(0) result to this+0xC; runs only under the a2==0 && a4==0 guard, otherwise returns -1. Called by SoundEventDispatcher.

Retirement/failure commentary handler: gated by race-active, track-state, session-type (7), race-phase (!=8) and championship-mode (!=5) flags. Sentinel-initializes a driver-table entry; for the player vehicle (field +0x4894 match) maps reason code to event IDs 119/118/117; for AI vehicles derives a context index (FloatRangeIndexLookup on field +0x4044, default 3) and maps the reason code to event IDs 235/238/236/237 with field +0x489C as context; inserts the entry via InsertDriverTableEntry only when the built entry is not the -1 sentinel.

Player-vehicle selector: computes the player vehicle pointer as vehicle-array base plus 18624 * slot index, stores it in dword_7C54E0, scans the 104-entry dword_7C54F0 pointer array for a match, records the matching index in dword_7C54DC and returns it (or 104 when absent).

Alternate player-vehicle selector: computes the player vehicle pointer (base plus 18624 * slot) into dword_7C54E8, scans dword_7C54F0 for a match, records the index in dword_7C54E4 and returns it (or 104 when absent).

Builds the global 104-entry active-vehicle pointer array: scans vehicle slots for live entries (dword at index 3250 != -1), zero-fills the unused tail, backfills remaining slots with not-yet-listed live vehicles, then records the array indices of the two reference vehicle pointers into dword_7C54DC (CurrentPlayerIndex) and dword_7C54E4 (CurrentVehicleIndex); returns the active vehicle count.

Vehicle-setup parameter value formatter for the garage/setup menu: the option index selects a 64-byte per-option slot and dispatches through a large switch (50+ cases) to the correct format specifier and unit conversion (metric/imperial from this+0x4; cm-to-inch 0.3937007874015748, radian-to-degree 57.29577951308232, liter-to-gallon 0.2641720372841846, RPM 9.549296585513721), with localized labels via BinarySearchInStringTable into byte_5EC4CC; several cases delegate to SetupValueFormatDS/1fS/WithOffset. Called only from MenuOptionValueDisplay.

Vehicle performance-estimate formatter: computes acceleration and top-speed estimates with a numeric-integration loop over BrakeTemperatureFadeModel (0x00430A50) and a cornering estimate via sub_430750, selecting metric (150 km/h bound) or imperial (100 mph bound) presentation from byte_7D0474, resolving every label through BinarySearchInStringTable into the shared byte_5EC4CC scratch buffer, and writing the three estimation lines into this display buffers.

Static-data registration thunk: passes the address of sub_431BE0 (coerced to int) to BooleanToIntConversion (0x00587B3E) and returns the boolean-to-int result; reports the presence of a function pointer rather than executing it.

Physics-config object destructor: first reinitializes the object via SessionConfigDefaultInit (0x00432CC0), then frees up to three owned heap pointer fields (offsets 0x14, 0x8, 0x0) via FreeWrapper_7bcf under individual non-null guards, returning the last free result (or the saved field 0x8 value when that field was null). Called by AutoLoadEntryListLoader.

Unconditional vehicle-subsystem step: indexes the read-only global array dword_5F0F6C at element 4656 * a2 and passes the object plus the selected element to the AI driver-name loader, returning its result. Reached via NetCommPlayerSlotSync; the loader target has no recorded address.

Object teardown helper (structural twin of PhysicsObjectDestructor): default-initializes the object via SessionConfigDefaultInit, conditionally frees the three owned sub-buffers at offsets 0, 8 and 20 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, frees the object itself when the low bit of the flags argument is set, and returns the object pointer.

Physics-config initialization thunk: forwards its this pointer unchanged to ConstraintSolverParamInit (referenced only by name in the source text; no callee address recorded) and returns the callee's result. Called from sub_40DE60.

Per-frame brake/tire thermal integration and wear simulation on the live vehicle: converts brake force, slip and angular velocity into per-wheel heat, integrates temperatures toward ambient Kelvin offsets (flt_8AFEF0/flt_8AFEF4 + 273.16) with frame-time weighting and a drain term, clamps the integrated temperature, computes a wear/degradation term from torque and slip ratio, triggers a blowout-style transition that scales down brake/tire force fields on extreme slip, and dispatches pit-state or AI-phase transitions (AISessionPhaseCounter / PitStateSlotActivation) based on slip classification. Called by the vehicle physics integration step (0x00441650).

Physics subsystem initializer: initializes wheel dynamics via WheelDynamicsInit (0x0043E230), dispatches initialization of a physics subsystem object at this + 5548 via PhysicsSubsystemInitDispatcher (0x0056D410), and returns the result of clearing a physics buffer at this + 492.

classes.name: WheelContactProbe
classes.responsibility: Computes a wheel's contact patch position and terrain penetration: reads wheel geometry and a half-extent scalar (this+0 / this+4), queries the spatial terrain grid at the contact center and both side probes, and produces the compressed suspension height and lateral tilt.

classes.name: WheelProcessingStateMachine
classes.responsibility: Drives time-sliced processing of the vehicle wheel array (base this+0x134, stride 316, count this+0x130): three phases (friction, suspension, proximity) selected by this+0x16C, a per-run target grip float at this+0x170, and a phase/wheel index at this+0x174 with -1 as the idle sentinel.

classes.name: CollisionShapeData
classes.responsibility: Collision collision-shape data record: carries a 16-bit discriminator / output dword at this+8, a secondary output at this+0xC (bone index or size class per the mapping/classifying methods), a subtype constant at this+28, and a pass-through value at this+32; seeded with collision mass data by the type-1 initializer.

classes.name: SessionState
classes.responsibility: Live session/race state used for commentary and event handling: identifies the retiring vehicle (field +0x4894), the retirement reason code (field +0x4068), the AI context float (field +0x4044) and the driver context index (field +0x489C).

classes.name: VehiclePointerArrayRegistry
classes.responsibility: Manages the global 104-entry active-vehicle pointer array (dword_7C54F0) and its reference indices: builds the array from live vehicle slots (0x0042BC80), selects the player vehicle into the reference slots dword_7C54E0 / dword_7C54E8, and records the matched indices in dword_7C54DC / dword_7C54E4.

classes.name: SetupValueFormatter
classes.responsibility: Renders vehicle-setup parameter values to display strings: option-index switch (entry 0x0042F470) selects format specifier, unit conversion (metric/imperial from this+0x4), localized labels, and per-option slot data; shared helpers (0x0042F180 DS, 0x0042F1E0 1fS, 0x0042F260 with-offset) cover delegated layouts.

classes.name: VehicleStatsEstimator
classes.responsibility: Computes and formats vehicle performance estimates (acceleration, top speed, cornering G) into setup display buffers, using numeric integration over the brake-temperature fade model and unit selection from byte_7D0474.

classes.name: PhysicsObjectConfig
classes.responsibility: Physics/session-config style object with up to three owned heap allocations (offsets 0x0, 0x8, 0x14) torn down by SessionConfigDefaultInit then FreeWrapper_7bcf; the destructor (0x00433090) and its structural-twin teardown helper (0x00433E60) share the layout. Packet evidence does not prove these two receivers are the same type; the grouping is a proposal.

classes.name: CameraPhysicsUpdateReceiver
classes.responsibility: Per-frame camera/physics update receiver: holds an element count (this+0) and element array pointer (this+8) over which mode-ordered render physics and camera-shake writes are dispatched, and a coarse shake timestamp (this+0x6C).

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: Live vehicle object (per the corpus SDK naming) whose brake/tire thermal, slip and degradation state is integrated per frame by 0x00438130: brake-force and thermal inputs, a dynamics sub-object (this+0x15C) with angular-velocity doubles, the three-element temperature array (this+0x34C) integrated into this+0x364, slip-state classification (this+0x394) dispatching pit/AI callbacks, and blowout/lock transition scaling. Ownership is DERIVED from the calling context (vehicle physics integration step 0x00441650), not independently proven.

state_machines.name: WheelProcessingPhaseMachine
states: idle: phase index this+0x174 == -1 sentinel; on the next call a changed target grip re-initializes the machine (phase selector 0, index 0) and stores the new target at this+0x170.
friction_phase: phase selector this+0x16C == 0; per-wheel batch calls the friction callback (sub_4FB260) with the target grip.
suspension_phase: phase selector this+0x16C == 1; per-wheel batch calls the suspension callback (sub_4FAF60) on wheelArrayBase + 316 * index.
proximity_phase: phase selector this+0x16C == 2; per-wheel batch calls the proximity callback (VehicleProximity, sub_4FB2E0) on wheelArrayBase + 316 * index.
transitions: friction_phase -> suspension_phase: batch bound min(this+0x174 + 20, wheel count this+0x130) reaches this+0x130; phase selector set to 1, index reset to 0.
suspension_phase -> proximity_phase: batch bound reaches this+0x130; phase selector set to 2, index reset to 0.
proximity_phase -> idle: batch bound reaches this+0x130; phase selector reset to 0 and index set to -1.

interfaces.name: SetupOptionValueFormatter
interfaces.purpose: Renders a vehicle-setup option value to its display string: entry 0x0042F470 dispatches on option index through a large switch selecting format specifier, unit conversion (metric/imperial) and localized labels, delegating to shared helpers 0x0042F180 (DS), 0x0042F1E0 (1fS) and 0x0042F260 (with-offset).

interfaces.name: DriverEventTable
interfaces.purpose: Builds and inserts driver-table commentary entries for session events: sentinel-initializes an entry buffer (StructInitWithSentinelValues), looks up an entry by reason code and context with time conversion (DriverDataTableLookupAndTimeConversion, event IDs 117-119 player / 235-238 AI), and inserts it into the session event table (InsertDriverTableEntry).

interfaces.name: TerrainHeightQuery
interfaces.purpose: Spatial-grid terrain-height query at a 3D point; supplies ground height for wheel contact and suspension compression computation (center and side probes with failure fallback to the center height).

interfaces.name: LocalizedStringResolver
interfaces.purpose: Resolves label and format strings via BinarySearchInStringTable (0x00423A00) into the shared byte_5EC4CC scratch buffer for setup value and estimation display formatting.

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehiclePointerArray
compatibility_contracts.description: dword_7C54F0 must remain a 104-entry array of pointers to live vehicle slots; BuildActiveVehiclePointerArray appends each live slot (dword at index 3250 != -1), zero-fills and backfills the tail, and records the indices of the reference pointers dword_7C54E0 / dword_7C54E8 into dword_7C54DC / dword_7C54E4. SetPlayerVehicleIndex stores the computed player pointer (base 0x5EC6D8 + 18624 * slot) and returns the matching array index, or 104 when absent. A replacement executable must maintain the same array capacity, live-slot test and index-record semantics.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionEventTableInsertion
compatibility_contracts.description: Retirement/failure commentary must build a sentinel-initialized driver-table entry and insert it into the session event table referenced by flt_5EA618 only when the built entry's first word is not the -1 sentinel. Player vehicles map reason code to event IDs 119 (=1), 118 (=7) or 117 (other); AI vehicles derive a context index (FloatRangeIndexLookup on field +0x4044, default 3) and map reason code to event IDs 235 (=1), 238 (=4), 236 (=9) or 237 (other) using field +0x489C as context.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelProcessingTimeSlicing
compatibility_contracts.description: Wheel dynamics processing is time-sliced across frames: at most 20 wheels per call, three phases (friction sub_4FB260, suspension sub_4FAF60, proximity sub_4FB2E0) selected by this+0x16C over the wheel array at this+0x134 (stride 316, count this+0x130). The machine re-enters idle (phase selector 0, index -1) after a full batch, and re-initializes when the stored target grip at this+0x170 diverges from 1.0 - (flt_8AFEE8 + flt_8AFEEC) * 0.5 by more than 0.05.

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleSetupValueDisplay
compatibility_contracts.description: Setup value formatting must honor the unit flag (this+0x4, metric vs imperial) and the documented conversion factors (cm-to-inch 0.3937007874015748, radian-to-degree 57.29577951308232, liter-to-gallon 0.2641720372841846, RPM 9.549296585513721), resolve localized labels through BinarySearchInStringTable into the shared byte_5EC4CC scratch buffer, and produce per-option output through the 64-byte slot layout (2992/3000/3012/3020/3022 literals) with StringFormat-style buffer-overflow-checked writes.

compatibility_contracts.name: BrakeTireThermalIntegration
compatibility_contracts.description: Per-frame brake/tire thermal integration on the vehicle must accumulate per-wheel heat from brake force, slip and angular velocity toward ambient Kelvin targets (flt_8AFEF0/flt_8AFEF4 + 273.16), clamp the integrated temperature at this+0x364 (273.16 / 546.32 bounds), compute the wear term from torque and slip ratio, and on extreme slip trigger the blowout transition that zeroes this+0x394, writes this+0x398, scales this+0x384 by 0.18, this+0x234 by 4.0 and this+0x44C/0x278/0x454/0x288 by 0.7. Slip classification (this+0x394 vs 0.75) dispatches PitStateSlotActivation or AISessionPhaseCounter per slot this+0x78.
